CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2406 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (R10-ROSTER-FASTPATH, branch fix/r10-roster-fastpath), head d1becac2b30830c9fb20bda298056cc8577fb793. Never send push notifications.
The newest `Fix review:` (round 5) is blocked: red-at-head: tests/entities.py fails 2 graders-head-copy checks at the head (fast (3.14)), and the one-literal _PT_JOB_CANON fix the body names does not clear them; with it applied, 2 other checks fail because the harness executes the step in a planted repo that has no tests/closure.py. Read it in full. Fix soundly: make the graders-head-copy checks pass with the planted repo carrying what the step needs, never by weakening the check. This is past round 3: re-cut the body to the minimum the contract requires; if a part still cannot be made sound, say which part should split out in its own PR.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain is on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from origin/main and follow them exactly. Merge origin/main, never rebase. Re-execute steps 2-8 and re-take the body in full; answer every red check in `## Red checks`.
Return: push code to `handoff/r10-roster-fastpath` (fast-forward) and the body via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-roster-fastpath`. Push nothing else; do not open, edit, comment on or merge any PR. A fixer writes no delivery row. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha>.
